records.jp: やった！　追い返せた！
records.en_original: Yay! We sent it packing!
records.en_auxiliary: Yay! We sent it packing!
records.en: We did it! We drove it back!

records.jp: お疲れさま、ヒナちゃん
records.en_original: Nice work, Hina.
records.en_auxiliary: Nice work, Hina.
records.en: Nice work, Hina-chan.

records.jp: こ、これで倒せたの……？
records.en_original: D-Did we beat it?
records.en_auxiliary: D-did we beat it?
records.en: D-Did we beat it?

records.jp: ……ううん。まだ完全には倒せてない。<CR>あの原種はいったん引いただけ
records.en_original: ...No, not yet. That Sephira only retreated temporarily.
records.en_auxiliary: ...No, not yet. That Sephira only retreated temporarily.
records.en: ...No. We haven't defeated it completely.<CR>It only retreated for now.

records.jp: たぶん、他のポイントを狙いに行ってると思う
records.en_original: It's probably going after the other points now.
records.en_auxiliary: It's probably going after the other points now.
records.en: It's probably going after the other points now.

records.jp: 他の……？
records.en_original: The what?
records.en_auxiliary: The what?
records.en: The what?

records.jp: うん。この地球上にはね、22個の特異点みたいなものがあって、<CR>それぞれをリフレクターが守ってるの
records.en_original: There are 22 singular points on this earth, each one protected by Reflectors.
records.en_auxiliary: There are 22 singularities on Earth, each one protected by Reflectors.
records.en: There are 22 singularities on Earth,<CR>and each one is protected by Reflectors.

records.jp: ここ星ノ宮は17番目の特異点
records.en_original: We here at Hoshinomiya are the 17th singularity.
records.en_auxiliary: We here at Hoshinomiya are the 17th singularity.
records.en: Hoshinomiya is the seventeenth singularity.

records.jp: リフレクターは特異点の範囲内じゃないと<CR>力を発揮できないの
records.en_original: Reflectors can only unleash their powers within the singularities.
records.en_auxiliary: Reflectors can only unleash their powers within the singularities.
records.en: Reflectors can only use their powers<CR>within the range of a singularity.

records.jp: そ、それじゃあ、もし私たちがいない時にアイツが来たら――！？
records.en_original: Th-Then, if it comes back when we aren't here!?
records.en_auxiliary: Th-then, if it comes back when we aren't here?!
records.en: Th-Then what if it comes while we're gone--!?

records.jp: それは大丈夫！<CR>ユズたちはある程度なら予測できてるから
records.en_original: You don't have to worry about that! We can actually predict their attacks, at least to some degree.
records.en_auxiliary: You don't have to worry about that! We can actually predict their attacks, at least to some degree.
records.en: Don't worry!<CR>We can predict when they'll show up, to some extent.

records.jp: 不意打ちというのはまずありえない
records.en_original: There's no chance we'd be blindsided.
records.en_auxiliary: There's no chance we'd be blindsided.
records.en: There's no chance we'd be blindsided.

records.jp: そうなんだ……
records.en_original: That's a relief...
records.en_auxiliary: That's a relief...
records.en: That's a relief...

records.jp: ……あのさ。私――
records.en_original: ...Listen, I--
records.en_auxiliary: ...Listen, I—
records.en: ...Listen, I--

records.jp: 日菜子！
records.en_original: Hinako!
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako!
records.en: Hinako!

records.jp: 更紗……
records.en_original: Sarasa...
records.en_auxiliary: Sarasa...
records.en: Sarasa...

records.jp: ……すごいね、その力。なんだか魔法みたい
records.en_original: That was amazing. Your power...it's like magic!
records.en_auxiliary: That was amazing. Your power...it's like magic!
records.en: That power is amazing. It almost looks like magic.

records.jp: この姿、この力を使えば、踊れるんだけどね……
records.en_original: If only I could use that form all the time. Then I could actually dance again...
records.en_auxiliary: If only I could use that form all the time. Then I could actually dance again...
records.en: In this form, with this power, I can dance...

records.en_original: Oh...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh...

records.jp: でも、さっきの奴を、原種を全部倒せば願いが一つ叶えられるんだ
records.en_original: But if I can defeat those things--those Sephirot--I get to have one wish come true.
records.en_auxiliary: But if I can defeat those things—those Sephira—I get to have one wish come true.
records.en: But if I defeat all of them--all the Sephira--I get one wish.

records.jp: 私の“願い”なんて……、決まってる！
records.en_original: And I've chosen my wish!
records.en_auxiliary: And I've chosen my wish!
records.en: I already know what my wish is!

records.jp: 私は、もう一度バレエを踊れるようになる
records.en_original: I want to be able to dance ballet again.
records.en_auxiliary: I want to be able to dance ballet again.
records.en: I'll dance ballet again.

records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 更紗の気持ちと向き合った時に思い出したんだ。<CR>怪我した直後の気持ち
records.en_original: When I faced your feelings, the way I felt right after I got hurt came rushing back.
records.en_auxiliary: When I faced your feelings, the way I felt right after I got hurt came rushing back.
records.en: Facing your feelings made me remember<CR>how I felt right after I got hurt.

records.jp: バレエがない私なんて、死んでるのと同じ……
records.en_original: Without ballet, it's as if I'm dead...
records.en_auxiliary: Without ballet, it's as if I'm dead...
records.en: Without ballet, it's as if I'm dead...

records.jp: 日菜子……
records.en_original: That's so...
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako...
records.en: Hinako...

records.jp: だから、私は戦う！<CR>原種を全部倒して、またステージに立つ！
records.en_original: But that's why I'm going to fight! I'll defeat all the Sephirot, and take to the stage again!
records.en_auxiliary: But that's why I'm going to fight! I'll defeat all the Sephira, and take to the stage again!
records.en: That's why I'm going to fight!<CR>I'll defeat all the Sephira and return to the stage!

records.jp: よくわからないけど……、私も協力してあげる
records.en_original: This is all a little overwhelming, but... I'll help you, however I can.
records.en_auxiliary: This is all a little overwhelming, but... I'll help you, however I can.
records.en: I don't really understand, but... I'll help you too.

records.jp: 更紗……ありがとう……
records.en_original: Thank you, Sarasa.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, Sarasa.
records.en: Thank you, Sarasa.

records.jp: あ、あなたのためじゃない。あくまで自分のためよ。<CR>ライバルがいないと張り合いがないもの！
records.en_original: H-Hey, I'm not doing this for you, I'm doing it for me. <CR>I need a rival to compete against!
records.en_auxiliary: H-hey, I'm not doing this for you, I'm doing it for me.<CR>I need a rival to compete against!
records.en: I-I'm not doing this for you. I'm doing it for me.<CR>I need a rival to compete against!

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: Sure.
records.en_auxiliary: Sure.
records.en: Sure.

records.jp: ヒナちゃん……
records.en_original: Hina...
records.en_auxiliary: Hina...
records.en: Hina-chan...

records.jp: 私、これからもなるよ。リフレクターに
records.en_original: I've decided. I'm in this. I'm a Reflector.
records.en_auxiliary: I've decided. I'm in this. I'm a Reflector.
records.en: I'll continue as a Reflector.

records.jp: またバレエをできるようになって、エトワールになる
records.en_original: I'm going to dance again, and I'll become an étoile.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm going to dance again, and I'll become an étoile.
records.en: I'll dance ballet again and become an étoile.

records.jp: エトワール……？
records.en_original: Étoile...?
records.en_auxiliary: Étoile...?
records.en: Étoile...?

records.jp: フランス語で、“星”って意味だよね？
records.en_original: It means "star" in French, right?
records.en_auxiliary: It means "star" in French, right?
records.en: It means "star" in French, right?

records.jp: トップバレリーナのことをそういうの。<CR>私の、夢……
records.en_original: That's right. It's what a top ballerina is called. <CR>It's...my dream....
records.en_auxiliary: That's right. It's what a top ballerina is called.<CR>It's my dream...
records.en: That's what they call the top ballerina.<CR>It's my dream...

records.jp: ヒナちゃん……
records.en_original: Wow...
records.en_auxiliary: Wow...
records.en: Hina-chan...

records.jp: これからもよろしくね、ヒナちゃん！
records.en_original: Thanks, Hina. We'll be counting on you!
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks, Hina. We'll be counting on you!
records.en: Thanks, Hina-chan. We'll be counting on you!

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Heh.
records.en_auxiliary: Heh.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: それにしても、リフレクター……。反射するもの……
records.en_original: By the way, a Reflector... Has to reflect something, right?
records.en_auxiliary: By the way, a Reflector... Has to reflect something, right?
records.en: Reflector... One that reflects...

records.jp: なに？　ネーミングが気になる？
records.en_original: Why? Curious about the name?
records.en_auxiliary: What? Are you caught up on the name?
records.en: Why? Curious about the name?

records.jp: ううん。今の私にはぴったりだ
records.en_original: Not at all. It's perfect for me right now.
records.en_auxiliary: Not at all. It's perfect for me right now.
records.en: Not at all. It's perfect for me right now.

records.jp: エトワールみたいに、自ら輝くことはない
records.en_original: Like an étoile, it can't shine on its own.
records.en_auxiliary: I can't shine like an étoile on my own.
records.en: Unlike an étoile, a Reflector doesn't shine on its own.
